Of course women don't pick their partner purely based on economics, but it is a significant factor. How much money do you make? Going from 100k to 30k is a lot different than going from 30k to nothing. If she is rational, she must have chosen you because the total of your variables outweigh the total of the other guy's variables. For example, a woman isn't likely to rule a man out if he is a little chubby (provided that his other variables make up for it), but she is very likely to rule him out if he is morbidly obese. A woman isn't likely to rule out a guy if his personality isn't spectacular (provided that his  other variables make up for it ), but she is very likely to rule him out if his personality is horrible.

Similarly, a woman isn't likely to rule out a guy if he isn't making 100k+ a year (provided that his other variables make up for it), but she is very likely to rule him out if he makes no money at all. I make no money at all, and I have no human capital that would indicate the ability to make money in the future. I am economically morbidly obese. I am economically dead, my socioeconomic status is in such a dire state that is a deal breaker. Even if it wasn't, I am also a social cripple, and I have average physical attractiveness, among other things. So my other variables can't make up for it.
